messages:
nina: opened a docs PR that consolidates the Private/VPC networking migration guide and converts several curl SDK examples into Go + Node snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4917

raj: great — only ask is to add an explicit section about asymmetric routing + MTU impact on gRPC streaming and token chunking. we saw 2 customers hit weird truncation on 1.25k mtu environments. add diagnostic tcpdump example.

ellie: i can add Go snippet for the embeddings route. i'll also add a short Node fetch example that shows streaming with EventSource polyfill. keep both under 40 lines.

docs-bot: linkcheck: found 2 broken links in the installer FAQ section (old internal KB). please update to /docs/install/priv-vpc-quickstart.

nina: fixed links and added MTU troubleshooting with tcpdump sample and guidance to set gRPC MaxRecvMsgSize. also added a migration checklist for on-prem customers: preflight network tests, KMS endpoint verification, HSM provider path checks.

ops-oncall: add runbook note: when migrating, toggle traffic via canary host and verify KV cache warmup to avoid cold-start spikes. include the exact curl sequence to prime caches.

paul: small security note: for the Node example, avoid embedding long-lived API keys in code snippets. replace with process.env.EXAMPLE_KEY and add a short paragraph on using Vault/KMS.

security: acked. requested a line about ensuring HSM PKCS11 module ownership perms (root vs service user) and a pointer to the Key Handling policy.

nina: updated PR with all items: Go + Node snippets, MTU/tracer tcpdump, cache-priming curl sequence, link fixes, and security pointers. pinging @docs-owners for final review.

ellie: LGTM from SDK examples POV.

docs-bot: docs-ci: all checks passed for PR 4917 (lint, linkcheck, snippet-run). artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/4917/:white_check_mark:

nina: merged after approvals. will follow up with a short support playbook summarizing the migration steps and sample commands. closing thread.
